Description: As a user, I can register with role-specific form (Parent, Student, Tutor). Dependencies: none.

As system, I enforce RBAC for Parent, Student, Tutor, Admin, Superadmin. Dependencies: US-002.

Summary: US-005 Admin route and API authorization
Description: As admin, I can access only authorized admin routes and APIs. Dependencies: US-004.
As system, I log authentication and sensitive action audit trails. Dependencies: US-004.
As Parent, I can create requirement with area, tuition type, subject, and notes. Dependencies: US-001, US-004.
As Parent, I can publish requirement. Dependencies: US-101.
As Parent, I can view my requirement list. Dependencies: US-102.
As Parent, I can track requirement status timeline. Dependencies: US-102.
As Parent, I can submit feedback for tutor and service. Dependencies: US-103.
As Student, I can create requirement with area and subject details. Dependencies: US-001, US-004.
As Student, I can publish requirement. Dependencies: US-201.
As Student, I can view my requirements. Dependencies: US-202.
As Student, I can track requirement status timeline. Dependencies: US-202.
As Student, I can submit feedback for tutor and service. Dependencies: US-203.
As Tutor, wallet is auto-created on registration. Dependencies: US-001.
As Tutor, I receive 15 trial credits at wallet creation. Dependencies: US-301.
As Tutor, I can view open requirements list. Dependencies: US-102, US-202, US-004.
As system, credits are debited when tutor unlocks contact phone or premium requirement details. Dependencies: US-302, US-303.
As Tutor, I can view wallet transactions and current balance. Dependencies: US-304.
As Tutor, I can recharge credits using payment gateway. Dependencies: US-305.
As Tutor, I can schedule demo with Parent or Student. Dependencies: US-303.
As Tutor, I can submit feedback after demo. Dependencies: US-307.

Summary: US-309 Tutor feedback for parent student

As Tutor, I can raise support ticket and track responses. Dependencies: US-001.

As Admin, I can access analytics for users, requirements, and matches. Dependencies: US-403.

As Admin, I can respond and manage tutor support tickets. Dependencies: US-311, US-401.

As Admin, I can check matched profiles with score and reason. Dependencies: US-501, US-401.
